source: LINCS GSE106127 CGS PRIME RNAi, >=3 hairpins and positive consistency, >=3 contexts/target
transformation: Cell-line center using all eligible interventions, quality^2 weighted consensus, downweight sign disagreement, standardize landmarks and PCA64/L2-normalize. All 300 competition target genes removed from output landmarks; each remaining perturbed gene own landmark zeroed before aggregation.
outcome_scope: PCA uses independent RNAi phenotypes only; no held CRISPR response or competition outcomes. z-score units are never treated as counts or LFC. Cross-assay mapping is fitted separately.
